ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions.

2. When practising Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.

3. When practising Language Use, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language Use.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Language Use.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Use.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language Use.

4. When practising Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.

6. When practising Phonological Awareness: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness: Fluency.

7. When practising Guided Reading: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Reading: Fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Guided Reading: Fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Reading: Fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Guided Reading: Fluency.

8. In ARABIC LANGUAGE, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

9. When practising Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.

----
